newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Russian businessman shot in Swedish car park.
newsitem.headline: Russian businessman shot in Swedish car park.

text.p: Swedish police investigating the shooting of a Russian businessman in a car park in the southern Swedish town of Malmo have named the victim as Evgueni Goloubtchik.

Goloubtchik, 46, was shot several times when a masked man riding a mountain bike opened fire on him and his teenage son as they loaded goods into a car at the Jagersro shopping centre around lunchtime on Saturday.
He died in an ambulance on the way to hospital.
"We still have no motive for the shooting," police spokesman Torsten Elofsson told Reuters.
He said suggestions that the killing was linked to organised crime in Russia were pure speculation.
"But we are leaving all the doors open. We are interviewing his business partners and trying to work out which companies he had interests in."
Elofsson said Goloubtchik was joint owner of a company called NB Shipping and may have been the agent in Sweden for Russia's Murmansk Shipping Company.
Police were on Sunday continuing to hunt for the gunman, who was described as in his early thirties and strangely dressed.
Goloubtchik had lived in Malmo with his family since 1994.
